user.title: Set up ZHA Sonoff Quirks
user.description: Click Submit to enable the ZHA Sonoff Quirks integration. It registers the bundled ZHA custom quirks for SONOFF Zigbee devices (currently the SWV-ZF2 dual-channel water valve). There is nothing to configure here. A Home Assistant restart may be required for the quirks to apply to already-joined devices, followed by a Reconfigure on the device.

abort.already_configured: ZHA Sonoff Quirks is already set up.
